manage.label: Manage Shopify
manage.description: Connect a Shopify store, change its sync settings and retry order imports

card.title: Shopify
card.description: Import Shopify orders and push stock to your store.

page.title: Shopify
page.description: Shopify orders become Inventoros orders, and Inventoros stock is published to Shopify. Products are matched by SKU.

status.acting_user: Orders and stock changes are recorded as {name}.

connection.title: Connection
connection.subtitle: The Shopify app's credentials, from the Dev Dashboard (App settings).
connection.client_secret_saved: Saved. Leave empty to keep it.
connection.disconnect_confirm: Disconnect Shopify? Orders already imported stay; the stored credentials are deleted.

sync.title: Sync settings
sync.import_orders_hint: New Shopify orders become Inventoros orders and take stock out; cancelling in Shopify cancels them here.
sync.push_inventory_hint: Every stock change in Inventoros sets the available quantity in Shopify. Inventoros is the source of truth.
sync.locations_hint: Choose which Inventoros stock each Shopify location shows. Leave a location unsynced to manage its stock in Shopify. With several locations, give each its own warehouse.
sync.warehouse_hint: Used when the order's Shopify location is not mapped to a warehouse.
sync.location_hint: Save the connection first to load the store's locations.

webhooks.title: Order webhooks
webhooks.subtitle: Shopify notifies Inventoros of new and cancelled orders at this address. It must be public and HTTPS.

stock.title: Stock sync
stock.subtitle: Match every Shopify variant to Inventoros by SKU and push all quantities. Run it once after connecting, and whenever SKUs change in bulk.

recovery.title: Order recovery
recovery.subtitle: Every ten minutes Inventoros reads back the orders Shopify changed, so orders whose webhook was lost are still imported, and edits, fulfilments and refunds still apply. Missing webhooks are registered again.
recovery.from_hint: Shopify keeps the last 60 days of orders available to apps.

catalogue.title: Catalogue
catalogue.subtitle: Copy products between Shopify and Inventoros, matched by SKU. Products that already exist on the other side are never changed.
catalogue.import_hint: Creates an Inventoros product for each Shopify product whose SKUs Inventoros does not have, with its options and variants.
catalogue.with_stock: Also import Shopify's available stock as opening stock
catalogue.publish_hint: Creates a Shopify product for each active Inventoros product whose SKUs Shopify does not have, with prices, barcodes and stock at the mapped locations.
